Freedom Town croquetas de jamón.d: Serrano ham béchamel, crumbed and fried golden. Lime.
Freedom Town croquetas de jamón.note: Camp food, before the green card.

Tostones.d: Green plantain fried twice, smashed flat, garlic and lime mojo.
Tostones.note: A crisp side from the Little Havana counter.

Ropa vieja.d: Flank steak shredded into peppers, tomato, olives. Rice, beans.

The World Is Yours guava pastelitos.d: Puff pastry, guava paste and cream cheese, sugar crust.
The World Is Yours guava pastelitos.note: Lesson number one: never underestimate the pastelitos.

Babylon Club mojito.d: White rum, lime and mint over crushed ice, soda on top.
Babylon Club mojito.note: Ask for a booth. Nobody here is your baby.
